blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, United States — Massive waves carried on king tides battered California’s coast Wednesday, prompting evacuations and soaking San Francisco, but sparing feared mass disruptions to Thanksgiving holiday travel. San Francisco already recorded its highest November water levels in more than 40 years on Tuesday morning, according to the National Weather Service (NWS). On Wednesday, local media reported waves reaching as high as 30 feet (9.14 meters) at Ocean Beach, San Francisco’s main beach. Powerful waves broke an old wooden pier in Pacifica, a small town about a 20 minute drive south, where high tides also caused flooding in some […]...
